narration: Your AI answer looks right. Will your automation accept it?
My next step needs a contact name and email. A readable answer still has to meet that input contract.
These four samples are handwritten teaching data, not captured mistakes from an AI model.
The first puts a sentence before the data. Python rejects it as invalid JSON, before checking the fields.
The second is valid JSON but has no email field. Parsing successfully does not make the record complete.
The third puts a number in the email field. Our small contract requires text that is not blank instead.
The fourth supplies both fields as strings. It passes these checks, so the workflow can consider the next step.
That does not prove the email address exists, the information is accurate, or the person agreed to messages.
Check the format, then the required fields and types. Hold failed records and show a useful reason.
